_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF CoreDiscovery COMPOSITE profile UML. Holds no local class declarations beyond a placeholder anchor - it composes the two upstream profile-module configs (cdifCore + the tight cdifDiscovery) and lets the XMI pipeline merge their class graphs. Mirrors the JSON-Schema allOf at _sources/profiles/cdifCompositeProfile/CoreDiscovery/schema.yaml.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF CoreDiscovery Composite Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF CoreDiscovery Composite Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Composes CDIFCore + CDIFDiscovery
targetModel.definition: CoreDiscovery is the smallest CDIF composite profile that produces a discovery-ready dataset metadata record. Assembled from two building-block profile modules: cdifCore (the foundational schema:Dataset shape - identifiers, distribution, agents, license, ...) and cdifDiscovery (measurementTechnique, variableMeasured, spatialCoverage, temporalCoverage, hasQualityMeasurement). A metadata record validating against this composite must declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/core/1.1 and https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.1.

package.name: Composition
package.definition: Local placeholder package. The composite has no classes of its own beyond what its two composed modules contribute.

class._comment: Placeholder anchor for composite-level constraints. Carries no real attributes; the composite's content comes entirely from the two composed modules' classes.
class.definition: Placeholder for the CoreDiscovery composite. All concrete classes come from the composed modules (CDIFCore, CDIFDiscovery) - this class has no instances.
